summary.text: Bill DeMora is a Democratic state senator from Ohio who has represented District 25 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia, which lists him as William DeMora, describes a career in Democratic Party and environmental advocacy organizations.

paragraphs.text: William DeMora was born in Euclid, Ohio, graduated from Euclid High School, and earned a degree from The Ohio State University in 1989.

His career experience includes work as a youth and campus coordinator for the Clinton/Gore 1996 presidential campaign, president of the Ohio Young Democrats, and executive director of the Ohio Democratic Party and the Ohio League of Conservation Voters.
He was also a consultant for the Ohio Democratic Party and for Strategies Unlimited.
DeMora took office in the Ohio Senate on January 1, 2023, succeeding Kenny Yuko.
In 2023–2024 his committee assignments included Energy and Public Utilities, General Government, Insurance, Local Government and Transportation.
He defeated Jesse Baker in the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary, 56.1% to 43.9%, and faces Republican Don Roberts and write-in independent Raisheda Angus in the general election.
